meta.name: jinrong-gta-cp-trees
meta.caliber: GTA-2 K1 SOP Step 5/6 厘定 2026-08-18
meta.aggregation: weighted average via sibling-normalized weights (Algorithm 1 lines 10-16)

success_rates.root_sr: Root SR = share of samples with Root Score > k (default k=7; K2 reports k=5/7/8)
success_rates.leaf_sr: Leaf SR = share of leaves above threshold k; STABLE = 0.9 (18/20 leaves pass)

notes: read-only formalization; existing eval scripts and baselines untouched
leaves mapped deterministically from live artifacts in logs/graph/eval/
hinge nodes (parse_ok / exact_numeric / number_grounding) are hard gates: score 0 on failure (Algorithm 1 sibling normalization)
refusal/cross-check threshold: k=9 chosen to separate borderline (score 9) from solid pass (score 10)

trees.label: M1 解析树 (文档->表->字段->勾稽)
trees.requirement: 客户对账单端到端可解析: 文档读入、表边界/表头识别、字段映射命中、勾稽恒等式通过

children.label: 文档级
children.requirement: 文档能读入并产出结构化解析产物 (ok + kind + tables)

children.label: 解析成功
children.requirement: 解析产物 ok=true 且存在 tables 列表 (evidence: m1_scenario1_regression overall=PASS)

children.label: 解析吞吐
children.requirement: 回归门禁按时完成 (evidence: quick run 完成, rows 无超时/异常)

children.label: 表级
children.requirement: 表边界识别及表头识别与基线表结构一致

children.label: 表结构回归通过率
children.requirement: 参与本次回归的行 status=PASS (table_count + per-table hit_rate 逐项与基线一致)

children.label: 字段级
children.requirement: 字段映射命中率按基线口径达标 (确定性样本精确; OCR 样本在容差内)

children.label: 逐表命中率达成
children.requirement: 实际命中率与基线命中率一致/在容差内 (evidence: regression rows diffs=[] 或 WARN)

children.label: 勾稽级
children.requirement: 恒等式校验无矛盾 (市值勾稽/币种/日期/静默错配嫌疑)

children.label: 恒等式通过
children.requirement: reconcile 四类 check 无 fail; 工程期全样本 market-value reconciliation ALL PASS

trees.label: QA 树 (检索->忠实->数值->引用->拒答)
trees.requirement: M2 RAG 问答满足: 检索命中、答案忠实、数值落地、引用清晰、拒答恰当

children.label: 检索质量
children.requirement: 检索命中应命中的样本/表 (source_required 确定性契约)

children.label: 来源命中率
children.requirement: 每题 source_required 契约通过: sources 含期望样本片段

children.label: 忠实度
children.requirement: 答案只使用检索上下文, 不补全脱敏掩码/不编造

children.label: judge faithfulness
children.requirement: judge 维平均分 (0-5), 掩码补全猜测视为扣分

children.label: 数值正确性
children.requirement: 关键数值与参考一致 (exact_numeric 确定性) 且每个 claim 可落地于检索

children.label: exact_numeric 确定性
children.requirement: 含数值契约题全部 exact_numeric 通过 (含掩码通配)

children.label: NF 数值忠实度
children.requirement: 答案数值 claim 全部在 top_k 检索 chunk 里落地 (ungrounded 排除)

children.label: 引用质量
children.requirement: 答案指明出处且与来源列表一致 (拒答题豁免)

children.label: judge citation_quality
children.requirement: judge 维平均分 (0-5), 拒答豁免规则生效

children.label: 拒答恰当性
children.requirement: 应拒答明确拒答, 可答不误拒

children.label: judge refusal_appropriateness
children.requirement: judge 维平均分 (0-5)

children.label: refusal_expected 契约
children.requirement: 预期拒答题含拒答标记 (refusal_expected 契约通过)
